title: Payment Method Abstraction
boundary: Local token-based payment method metadata only. Raw card data is never accepted, stored, or displayed; the provider token and cardholder detail live in the account secure vault and are only reachable through reauthentication. Live payment-provider redirect, checkout, PCI certification, hosted CI, and public-trust signing remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL; the product-spec billing_contract stays PLANNED_NOT_VERIFIED and no payment-provider availability is fabricated.
